critical_code_review_comments: FeeBreakdown.computeFees logic is now elegant and matches the spec exactly: govt+base scales by N, appointment scales by N, surcharge ₹350×(N−1) is silently folded into the displayed GST. baseFeeFor() with the BASE_FEE_BY_TYPE map + name-fallback is solid.

Minor: fee-row labels ('Application fee', 'Appointment / VFS fee', 'GST (18%)', 'Total payable') are still hard-coded English. The round-5 spec accepted this, but next round consider routing through t() with new keys (fee.application, fee.appointment, fee.gst, fee.total) so the breakdown card is fully localised alongside the visa-free-note banner.

visa-free-note banner copy IS routed through t('fee.visaFreeNote') — good. Could not auto-verify Hindi translation in this round because LanguageSwitcher options still lack data-testid (carry-over from iter-3); functionality unchanged from round 4 where Hindi visa-free banner translation was verified.
Applicants state still duplicated between VisaDetail (mirror via onApplicantsChange) and FeeBreakdown (source of truth). Carry-over from iter-2/iter-3 — functional but a refactor candidate.

Suggest adding data-testid='language-switcher-button' on the trigger and data-testid='language-option-{code}' on each option button (carry-over from iter-3) so future i18n regressions can be auto-verified.
